penalties_range: Up to 3% of total revenue; up to 10% for repeat intentional/grossly negligent violations, breaches affecting >=10m people, or ignoring PIPC orders
deceased_data: Not covered: personal information concerns living individuals (art. 2(1)); may protect bereaved family's data
research_exemption: Pseudonymised data may be processed without consent for statistics, scientific research, public-interest archiving (art. 28-2); most rights excluded (art. 28-7)
genetic_data: Sensitive information: DNA information from genetic testing (art. 23; Enforcement Decree art. 18); separate consent or legal basis required
notes: 2026 amendment in force 2026-09-11: 10% revenue fines; CEO named ultimately responsible
